How they work

  • Runs in this page. The tool loads once, then works offline.
  • Nothing uploaded. Your video stays on your device. No account.
  • Pay once per tool. Paid through Polar, a checkout company. Taxes included. Refund within 14 days.
  • One key, no account. You come back from the checkout and the tool is already unlocked. The key is shown in the tool and emailed to you, for your own other devices, and a key opens whatever it was bought for.
